name: A Chance For Neko
source:
Ludwig was heading home from work, when he found a young neko named Feliciano. Not wanting the boy to live on the streets, Ludwig takes him in.

Axis Powers Hetalia AU, based on a [url=https://www.fanfiction.net/s/8442417/1/A-Chance-For-Neko]fanfic[/url] by BakaNekoItaly.

[Edited from [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/a-chance-for-neko.shtml]Ren'Py Games List[/url]]
translation:
路德维希下班回家时，发现了一个名叫费里西亚诺的年轻猫。路德维希不想让这个男孩流落街头，于是收留了他。
